renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] Difference is not cut off from its ground — free, most-clear, one-abode — then the bare list against the jewel-mirror: palace through mountain, just as from jewel-mirror and the like.

paragraphs.text: Being different does not cut you off from what you come from — the ground is free, perfectly clear, and all one house. Then just look at the plain list: palace, elephant, horse, cloud, ocean, mountain — the same way things show up in a jewel or a mirror.
